//: Static-analysis tooling, kept deliberately OUT of the root composer.json.
The root vendor/ tree is committed to git so a deployment needs no composer run.
Adding phpstan/rector there would (a) add ~69 MB / ~3100 files to every clone and
release zip, and (b) put their bootstrap files into vendor/composer/autoload_files.php,
which vendor/autoload.php requires on EVERY request - so if those packages were then
gitignored to control the size, a fresh clone would fatal on every page load.
Installing them here instead keeps the root vendor/ production-only and untouched.
tools/vendor/ is gitignored; run `composer install -d tools` to get them.
